summary: This bill amends federal law to specify that operating an unlicensed money transmitting business includes knowingly exercising control over currency, funds, or other value that substitutes for currency.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends a section of Title 18 of the U.S. Code, which deals with crimes and criminal procedure. Specifically, it modifies the definition of an unlicensed money transmitting business to include entities that exercise control over currency or other value that substitutes for currency. This change expands the scope of what constitutes an illegal financial activity, potentially leading to stricter enforcement against certain blockchain-related businesses, thus aligning with stricter justice.
